description: Links an organism to a protein it encodes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting the organism–protein relationship; includes UniProt.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or its supporting sources changed.

source_contributions.scope: Regular UniProt proteins with an organism represented in SPOKE; polyprotein cleavage products are excluded. Viral proteins link to their own organism, rather than to a host. Existing relationships may include retired UniProt proteins, whose retirement is recorded on the Protein node.
source_contributions.description: Organism assignments originate from the UniProt OX NCBI Taxonomy identifier and reflect representative-strain remapping. The relationship does not record the original taxon before remapping or indicate whether remapping occurred. Each eligible protein has one supported UniProt relationship to its assigned organism.
